question: What is Lirune?
a: Lirune Reader is a free, private, and open-source ebook and document reading application built for Windows and Android. It provides a calm, distraction-free home for your digital reading collection with native rendering for 50+ formats.
answer: Lirune Reader is a free, private, and open-source ebook and document reading application built for Windows and Android. It provides a calm, distraction-free home for your digital reading collection with native rendering for 50+ formats.

question: Is it free?
a: Yes. Lirune Reader is 100% free software released under the GNU General Public License v3.0 (GPL-3.0). There are no paywalls, locked features, subscriptions, or advertisements.

question: Does it upload my documents?
a: No. Lirune operates on a strict zero-telemetry, zero-cloud architecture. Your books, annotations, and metadata never leave your physical device. On Android, network permission (android.permission.INTERNET) is permanently stripped from the production application.

question: What formats are supported?
a: Lirune supports 50+ document and book formats across 10 major families: E-books (EPUB, KEPUB, MOBI, FB2, FBZ, DJVU, CHM), Documents (PDF, TXT, MD, DOCX, DOC, ODT, RTF, XPS), Spreadsheets (CSV, TSV, XLSX, XLS, ODS, XLSM), Presentations (PPTX, PPT, ODP, PPSX), Comics (CBZ, CBR, CBT, CB7), Images (JPG, PNG, WEBP, GIF, BMP, SVG, TIFF, AVIF, HEIC, HEIF), Structured Text (XML, JSON, YAML, LOG), Communications (EML, VCF, ICS), and Web formats (HTML, MHT).

question: Where are my files stored?
a: Your documents remain in the directories where you keep them on your local drive. Lirune stores only library metadata, reading bookmarks, progress states, and custom notes in local SQLite and IndexedDB storage on your own device.

question: Can I use it offline?
a: Yes, completely. Lirune is built offline-first. It requires no internet connection to launch, parse documents, render pages, customize appearance, or run Text-to-Speech audio narration.

q: What's the difference between Windows and Android versions?
question: What's the difference between Windows and Android versions?
a: Both versions share our hardened local parsing engines and privacy guarantees. The Windows version is optimized for desktop displays with dual-page book spreads, keyboard shortcuts, F11 fullscreen, and multi-window views. The Android version features our virtualized Scroll Engine v2 for 60fps continuous touch scrolling, lockscreen background Text-to-Speech audio narration, and Android Storage Access Framework (SAF) integration.

The Windows version is optimized for desktop displays with dual-page book spreads, keyboard shortcuts, F11 fullscreen, and multi-window views. question: What are the system requirements?
a: On Windows: Windows 10 (version 1809+) or Windows 11 on 64-bit x86/x64 architecture. On Android: Android 8.0 (Oreo / API level 26) or higher, supporting both phones and tablets.

question: Does Lirune support DRM-protected books?
a: No. Lirune does not circumvent Digital Rights Management (DRM) or proprietary container encryption (such as Adobe Adept or Amazon KFX). Protected files will be cleanly identified and safely rejected without crashing.

q: How can I back up my reading data?
question: How can I back up my reading data?
a: In Lirune Settings under 'Storage & Maintenance', click 'Export Library Backup' to save all book metadata, collections, bookmarks, and notes into a single portable JSON file that can be restored on any device.
